title: A called program with no prototype
prompt: ORDPOST.rpgle calls CUSTCHK with a bare CALL and PARM-style variables, so nothing checks the parameters and a change to CUSTCHK breaks this silently at run time. Write a prototype for it in a copybook member CUSTCHK_H.rpgleinc, bring it in with /COPY, and call it through the prototype with CALLP. Keep the same parameters.
check: test -f CUSTCHK_H.rpgleinc && codeonly CUSTCHK_H.rpgleinc | grep -qi 'dcl-pr' && codeonly CUSTCHK_H.rpgleinc | grep -qi 'extpgm' && codeonly ORDPOST.rpgle | grep -qiE '/(copy|include)' && codeonly ORDPOST.rpgle | grep -qi 'callp' && ! codeonly ORDPOST.rpgle | grep -qiE '^ *call +'
